_comment: Entry to add to modelcontextprotocol/servers upstream. Upstream has historically used a bulleted README list (Community Servers section) but has been restructured repeatedly in 2025-2026. Pick the variant that matches the CURRENT state of main before editing. All three formats below are semantically equivalent — Wael only commits ONE of them to the upstream repo.
variant_a_readme_bullet: - **[Blockchain Academics](https://github.com/blockchainacademics/bca-mcp)** — Canonical crypto MCP: 99 tools across news, entities, academy lessons, market data, on-chain, sentiment, proprietary indicators, and agent-backed research generation. Hybrid `attribution.citations[]` ships the real upstream URL first (Bankless, CoinGecko, Etherscan, SEC, …) plus the BCA editorial deep-link for ground-truth attribution. Zero-config demo on first run (no API key needed): `npx -y @blockchainacademics/mcp`
variant_b_readme_table_row: | [Blockchain Academics](https://github.com/blockchainacademics/bca-mcp) | `@blockchainacademics/mcp` | Canonical crypto MCP — 99 tools spanning news, entities, academy, market data, on-chain, sentiment, proprietary indicators, and agent-backed generation. Hybrid citations: real upstream URL first, BCA deep-link second. |

variant_c_manifest_entry.name: Blockchain Academics
variant_c_manifest_entry.description: Canonical crypto MCP — 99 tools spanning news, entities, academy, market data, on-chain, sentiment, proprietary indicators, and agent-backed generation. Wraps api.blockchainacademics.com with a hybrid `attribution.citations[]` envelope on every response (real upstream URL first, BCA editorial deep-link second).
highlights: Zero-config first run (v0.5.0+): `npx -y @blockchainacademics/mcp` works without any API key — the package ships with a public demo key that unlocks 10 marquee tools (price, trending, fear-greed, market overview, news search, sentiment, entity, explainer, recent stories, topic). 100/day shared cap + 20/day per-IP guard.

99 tools across 19 categories (news, market data, on-chain, sentiment, proprietary indicators, agent-backed generation, directories, fundamentals, chain-specific, microstructure, narrative, regulatory, security, memes, compute/AI, services, history, corpus meta, memos/theses/social/currencies)

Hybrid `attribution.citations[]` envelope: citations[0] is the real upstream URL (Bankless, CoinGecko, Etherscan, SEC, DefiLlama, …), citations[1] is the BCA editorial deep-link. LLMs get true provenance first.

Honest `meta.status` enum on every response (complete | unseeded | partial | stale) — vendor-degraded and not-yet-ingested data are explicitly flagged with structured `meta.diagnostic` rather than masked as empty arrays. `meta.tier` and `meta.upgrade_url` carry tier hints back to agents.
Battle-tested: 1,820 sustained-load calls, 91% zero-error, 0 citation drift (2026-06-02).
Security hardening (H-1 + H-2 + H-3 + MCP-TS-2): BCA_API_BASE allowlist, prompt-injection fencing on tool data, webhook SSRF guard, redirect rejection.

decision_notes: If upstream README.md on main uses a plain bulleted list under 'Community Servers', use variant_a_readme_bullet.
If upstream switched to a markdown table with columns (Server | Package | Description), use variant_b_readme_table_row.

If upstream migrated to a JSON/YAML manifest (e.g. community-servers.json) for programmatic listing, adapt variant_c_manifest_entry to the current schema. The fields in variant_c are a superset — prune to match.
In all cases: keep the diff to a single file and a minimal addition (1 line for README variants; 1 entry for manifest variants). Reviewers reject mega-diffs.
